text: Kaggle Solutions Skills 是面向 DSH 的研究插件，通过 Cordis 工具接入本地离线档案，帮助研究者检索历史 Kaggle 比赛与解法线索、查看经过整理的方法卡、创建分工明确的研究计划，并按条件查找可迁移的实验方向。它提供统计、搜索、比赛详情、方法卡和研究场景查询，也能为指定场景生成角色任务包与依赖图。适合需要从历史竞赛经验中寻找研究起点的 Kaggle 参与者；档案线索仍需核对原始来源，工具不会训练模型或提交比赛。基础检索离线可用；可选的 Kaggle 正文读取需要配置 Kaggle API token。

Kaggle Solutions Skills adds Cordis tools to search an offline archive of past competitions, solution links and method cards, then create role-based research plans. Use it to find experiment leads and verify sources. It does not train or submit; optional Kaggle writeup retrieval needs an API token.
想从往届 Kaggle 比赛里找相似问题和可参考的解法。
帮我检索历史竞赛资料，整理值得验证的机器学习方法。
我想按比赛类型搜索冠军方案和相关方法卡。
让 DSH 根据一个真实比赛场景生成分工研究任务。
Find historical Kaggle competitions with similar solution approaches.
Help me turn past competition writeups into experiments to validate.
Create a research plan with evidence, validation, transfer, and review roles.
Kaggle Solutions Skills 的功能「搜索离线竞赛档案」：提供关键词和可选模态筛选，返回匹配比赛及标记为 linked_unread 的解法链接。
Kaggle Solutions Skills 的功能「查询整理过的方法卡」：按方法词检索经整理的决策卡，并返回来源、迁移条件和实验假设。
Kaggle Solutions Skills 的功能「生成研究任务计划」：选择历史场景后生成含侦察、证据、验证、迁移和评审角色的任务包与依赖关系，不会启动 agent。
Kaggle Solutions Skills 的功能「读取 Kaggle 解法正文」：可选读取器按 Kaggle 讨论链接取回原帖正文并记录来源；需要 API token。
Kaggle 正文读取器需要 KAGGLE_API_TOKEN 或本地 Kaggle token；离线档案搜索本身无需账号。来源读取接口可能变化。

After finding a winning solution, you still need to assess its validation, decide what transfers to your data, combine research from several agents, and carry useful lessons into the next competition.

@haoxuanjng-lang/kaggle-solutions-skills README · Introduction：This project uses [faridrashidi/kaggle-solutions](https://github.com/faridrashidi/kaggle-solutions) as a discovery index. The result: **related solutions, validation risks, and comparable minimal experiments**.

@haoxuanjng-lang/kaggle-solutions-skills README · 🧭 Workflow：| Stage | Output | Evidence to preserve |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Discover** | Similar competitions and candidate solutions | Competition, links, rank leads, and upstream version |
| **Read** | Evidence from original material and code | Author statements, code locations, and access status |
| **Distill** | Method cards with conditions | Prerequisites, failure conditions, and source references |
| **Hand off** | Minimal controlled experiments | Target hypothesis, validation design, and resource limits |
| **Feed back** | New evidence and counterexamples | Actual results, runtime environment, and version |

@haoxuanjng-lang/kaggle-solutions-skills README · Current pain points and what the plugin helps you do：| Current pain point | How Harness helps | Deliverable |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Many solutions are available, but their relevance to the current problem is unclear. | Search by problem, modality, and historical competition, then inspect solution leads. | Related competitions, author sources, and items to verify |
| Winning solutions contain many techniques; transfer can overlook validation and data boundaries. | Query method cards with conditions, then have evidence and validation agents investigate separately. | Preconditions, leakage risks, failure conditions, and minimal controls |
| Agents repeat searches, lose context, or mix author reports with actual experiments when merging results. | Generate separate task packets, a dependency graph, and source context for reviewer synthesis. | Research handoffs, unresolved disagreements, and experiment proposals |

@haoxuanjng-lang/kaggle-solutions-skills README · 当前痛点与插件能帮你做的事：| 当前痛点 | 在 Harness 中怎样解决 | 交付什么 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 找到很多方案，难以判断与当前问题是否相似 | 按问题、模态和历史比赛检索，并查看对应解法线索 | 相似比赛、作者来源和待核实项 |
| 冠军方案里有很多技巧，迁移时容易忽略验证与数据边界 | 查询条件化方法卡，让证据 Agent 与验证 Agent 分别研究 | 适用条件、泄漏风险、失败条件与最小对照 |
| 多 Agent 重复搜索、上下文丢失，汇总时混淆作者报告与实际实验 | 生成独立任务包、依赖图和来源上下文，由 reviewer 合成 | 可交接的研究结果、未解决分歧与实验建议 |

可以让 Harness 为新比赛找相似问题、比较某场比赛的解法、组织研究团队，或将实际实验反馈沉淀成知识。离线检索与任务生成直接可用；新的模型分析沿用你的 Harness 配置，实验与官方成绩由比赛执行 workflow 产生。

每个角色拿到独立任务、固定来源上下文、结果契约和前置结果路径。证据阅读与验证审查可以并行；迁移分析等待二者完成，最后由 reviewer 汇总可追溯发现、分歧和最小实验。

$kaggle-solutions-skills 用多 Agent 分析 OTTO 的召回与排序方案，审查验证泄漏，给出最小迁移实验。缺失的目标指标保持未知。
